steps: Identify the `match` table which contains the match records and includes a date or datetime column (e.g., `match_date`, `date_played`, etc.).
Select all columns (or the desired columns) from the `match` table.
Add a WHERE clause to filter rows where the year part of the date column equals 2023 (e.g., `WHERE YEAR(match_date) = 2023` or `WHERE match_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'`).
Execute the query to retrieve all matches that were played in the year 2023.
